info.title: weddinvita API
info.description: Separate dashboard and invitation hosts. Admin APIs require the dashboard host and Origin; guest APIs require the invitation host and Origin. Cookies remain host-only, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Secure in production. Dashboard preview remains on the dashboard host. New guest links use /u/{code}, a 27-character random bearer credential. GET/HEAD only return gated HTML and public event metadata; Fingerprint verification grants access. The stable random tenant UUID remains the canonical public event URL. Legacy fragment links remain compatible until the explicit all-account credential cutover.

put.summary: Upload or replace a photo or background audio
put.description: Raw binary body, no multipart. Photos up to 12 MiB, decoded/re-encoded by libvips. Audio up to 25 MiB: MP3 (including consecutive leading ID3v2 tags), M4A/MP4 audio, AAC, WAV, OGG/Opus, FLAC and WebM audio. MP3 is validated and preserved; other audio is decoded and converted to MP3 for browser playback. Converted output must also fit 25 MiB. Malformed audio returns 415, oversized input/output 413 and a processing timeout 503. Failed uploads preserve existing media. The preview slot creates a public 1200×630 JPEG; other media remains session-protected. All resources are scoped to the authenticated tenant.

post.summary: Verify Fingerprint event and register up to three visitors
post.description: Server v4 API verifies event age, linked_id challenge, origin, visitor identity and anti-tampering signals. Atomic Postgres transaction deduplicates visitor, rejects fourth, consumes challenge/event and issues HttpOnly guest session. New distinct browsers follow the account deviceLimit (default 3) unless deviceLimitEnabled is false or the invitation is unlimited. Every accepted browser is recorded even with limits disabled. Existing browsers can return above a lowered limit; settings never erase records or revoke sessions.

put.summary: Save attendance and a congratulatory wish
put.description: Replace the current guest response, one per invitation shared across devices. Guest identity comes only from the active cookie session. Same-origin Origin header is mandatory; guests have no CSRF token. Attendance/count remain private to the guest and admin. Guest deletion cascades to their response. X-Invitation-Token must match responseToken from the displayed invitation. A changed guest session rejects stale forms with 409; this token never grants access without the cookie.

post.description: Public server webhook on CMS host; Origin/session/CSRF are not required. Verify SHA512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + ServerKey) in constant time and fetch actual status from Midtrans. Match stored order, amount, currency, and environment. Duplicate/out-of-order delivery cannot extend access twice or regress settlement. Server failures return 503 for retry. Authenticated test/unrelated orders are acknowledged with 200 without changing entitlement. GET/HEAD return connectivity health only and cannot activate access.

unlimited.description: True exempts this invitation from device limits. False follows account settings. Preserves access history and sessions.

deviceCount.description: Distinct verified browsers, including those admitted while limits are disabled. Never cleared by limit settings.

link.description: PUBLIC_ORIGIN/u/{code}, visible only to admins. Recoverable legacy links retain /{invitationId}#{secret} during rollout. Null when no valid recoverable credential was stored.

message.description: Trimmed plain text. Empty removes the wish. Visible to other invited guests.

unlimited.description: Bypass the account device limit for this invitation; defaults to false. Toggling preserves devices and sessions.

deviceLimit.description: Effective account limit, default 3. Null when globally disabled or this invitation is unlimited. Existing browsers and sessions remain valid above a lowered limit.

link.description: Invitation-host /u/{code} URL containing a cryptographically random 27-character code. Reissue revokes the old code, sessions and devices; legacy links remain readable until the explicit cutover.

id.description: Stable internal UUIDv7, independent of the editable slug and public invitation ID.

publicId.description: Random stable public invitation ID, independent of couple names and the internal tenant slug.

invitationOrigin.description: Configured invitation origin used to compose shared links; never inferred from the dashboard URL.

giftEnabled.description: Whether to show the gift-account section to guests.

giftAccounts.description: Gift information entries, each a bank account or an offline delivery address. An empty array removes all entries.

eventDate.description: Civil event date in YYYY-MM-DD. Empty or omitted uses the current invitation default; countdown and date tokens interpret it in WIB.

venueName.description: Public event venue label. Empty or omitted uses the current invitation default.

mapEmbedUrl.description: Empty or an HTTPS www.google.com/maps/embed URL; other origins rejected.

ceremonyTitle.description: Editable first event name; empty uses Prosesi Pernikahan.

receptionTitle.description: Editable second event name; empty uses Resepsi.

countdownTime.description: Countdown target time on countdownDate (or eventDate when omitted) in WIB (UTC+07:00). Empty defaults to 00:00.

whatsappTemplate.description: Global WhatsApp message. Supports {nama}, {link}, {tanggal}, {tempat}, {jam_acara_1}, {jam_acara_2}; {link} is required. Values follow event settings. Admin-only.

linkPreviewTitle.description: Public page and Open Graph title; empty derives from configured couple names.

linkPreviewDescription.description: Public description and Open Graph description; empty uses eventDate and venueName.

deviceLimitEnabled.description: Account-wide enforcement for every invitation, default true. Does not delete devices, sessions or challenges. Disabled mode still verifies and records browsers.

deviceLimit.description: Positive integer browser limit (1–2147483647), default 3, for all invitations without the unlimited exemption. Lowering the limit only blocks new browsers.

ceremonyDate.description: Optional event date in YYYY-MM-DD; empty or absent uses eventDate. Invalid calendar dates rejected.

ceremonyVenue.description: Optional event venue; trimmed. Empty or absent uses venueName.

receptionDate.description: Optional event date in YYYY-MM-DD; empty or absent uses eventDate. Invalid calendar dates rejected.

receptionVenue.description: Optional event venue; trimmed. Empty or absent uses venueName.

countdownDate.description: Countdown target date in YYYY-MM-DD, independent of ceremonyDate and receptionDate. Empty or absent uses eventDate.

Media.description: Slot URLs. Preview uses /preview-image/{id}, publicly readable; other slots use authenticated /media/{id}.

settings.description: Public settings only; whatsappTemplate is omitted.

message.description: Trimmed plain text. Empty removes the wish. Visible to other invited guests.

canRespond.description: Only a verified active guest can submit. False for admin/development previews.

tenantSlug.description: Tenant of the authenticated invitation. The browser uses it to guard requests after a cookie changes in another tab.

invitationId.description: Opaque tenant scope for invitation, wishes and response requests. Legacy tenantSlug remains for old clients.

responseToken.description: Opaque session binding for RSVP; empty in admin preview.

token.description: New guest code or legacy secret during cutover. Rotated legacy secrets are rejected by hash lookup.
